test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

To free from restraint
solution: ​The correct answer is '**Emancipate**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Emancipate**'. • It means 'to give somebody the same legal, social and political rights as other people'. (किसी व्‍यक्ति को वही क़ानूनी, सामाजिक और राजनीतिक अधिकार देना जो अन्‍य लोगों को प्राप्‍त है) • *Example: A New York court allowed Drew to **emancipate** herself from her mother's care at age 15.* **Correct Answer:__** *Emancipate.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Subjugate**: to defeat somebody/something and make them obey you; to gain control over somebody/something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु को परास्‍त करना; किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का दमन करना या उसे अपने अधीन करना) • **Escalate**: (to cause something) to become stronger or more serious. [(किसी स्थिति का) अधिक तीव्र होना या करना या अधिक गंभीर बनना या बनाना] • **Validate**: to show that something is true. (किसी बात को सत्‍य सिद्घ करना) e7:Tb8a, ​The correct answer is** '****withdrew all support'.**
